name: io.github.lubobali/lubot
title: LuBot Analytics
description: One AI agent for your files, website analytics and stock portfolio, in plain English.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description:
List the files the user uploaded to LuBot.

Returns file id, name, type, upload time and row or chunk count,
newest first. Use this when the user asks about their uploaded
files, and to find the file_id that analyze_file needs.

Limits: requires sign-in; up to 100 files. Users with no uploads yet
see demo files, clearly labeled.

tools.name: analyze_file
tools.description:
Answer a question about one of the user's uploaded files.

Reads the file's contents and returns LuBot's answer: numbers computed
from CSV / Excel tables, or text found in PDF, Word and image files, with
the file named as the source. Use this when the user asks about one
specific file; get the file_id from list_files first. Don't use it to
compare several files at once.

Limits: requires sign-in; counts toward the user's LuBot plan like a
My Files question; one file per call; answers can take up to a minute;
questions are capped at 2000 characters.

file_id.description: One of the file_ids returned by list_files.
file_id.title: File Id

question.description: The user's question about this file, in plain words.
question.title: Question

tools.name: ping
tools.description:
Check that the LuBot server is up.

Use this when you need to test the connection to LuBot. Returns a
status and the server version. Works without signing in.

tools.name: analyze_portfolio
tools.description:
Analyze the user's stock portfolio.

Returns concentration risk (low/medium/high), a diversification
score (0-10), a sector breakdown (looking through known ETFs), the
biggest stocks owned directly and through funds, the biggest winner
and loser by dollar impact.
Concentration looks at the biggest position, the biggest sector and
stocks held both directly and through funds. Use this when the user asks how diversified, concentrated or
risky their portfolio is. Don't use it just to list holdings (use
list_portfolio).

Limits: requires sign-in. Prices can be up to 7 days old; positions
without a price are labeled, never guessed.
Educational information, not investment advice.

tools.name: list_portfolio
tools.description:
List the user's stock portfolio holdings.

Returns each position (shares, average cost, current price, market
value, profit/loss, weight) from brokerage-linked and manually
entered trades, plus totals. Use this when the user asks what they
own or how their positions are doing. Don't use it for a public
ticker the user doesn't own (use stock_analysis).

Limits: requires sign-in. Prices are cached snapshots that can be up
to 7 days old; positions without a price are labeled, never guessed.
Users with no holdings yet see a demo portfolio, clearly labeled.

tools.name: stock_analysis
tools.description:
Public market numbers for one US stock or ETF.

Returns price, day change, 52-week range, market cap and trailing
P/E. Use this when the user asks about a specific ticker, for
example AAPL or BRK.B. Don't use it for the user's own holdings (use
list_portfolio) or for buy/sell decisions.

Limits: US tickers only; data from Yahoo Finance, up to 15 minutes
old; without sign-in there is a shared daily limit. When signed in,
the answer also says whether the ticker is on the user's watchlist.
Educational information, not investment advice.

ticker.description: US stock or ETF ticker, for example AAPL or BRK.B.
ticker.title: Ticker

tools.name: list_watchlist
tools.description:
List the tickers on the user's LuBot watchlist.

Returns each ticker and when it was added, oldest first. Use this
when the user asks which stocks they are watching. Don't use it for
holdings (use list_portfolio).

Limits: requires sign-in; up to 200 tickers.

tools.name: list_websites
tools.description:
List the websites the user can query in LuBot.

Returns each site's id and name. Use this when the user asks about
their website traffic, and to find the site_id that website_summary
needs.

Without sign-in it returns LuBot's public demo site (lubobali.com);
signed in, it returns the user's own sites. Signed-in users who
haven't connected a site yet see the demo site, clearly labeled.

tools.name: website_summary
tools.description:
Traffic summary for one website over a date range.

Returns page views, unique visitors and their change vs the same
number of days before, top countries, top pages, which AI bots read
the site (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and others), and the most
clicked buttons. Use this when the user asks how a site
is doing. Get the site_id from list_websites first.

Without sign-in only the public demo site works.

site_id.description: One of the site_ids returned by list_websites.
site_id.title: Site Id

start_date.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (included).
start_date.title: Start Date

end_date.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (included), at most 90 days after start_date.
end_date.title: End Date
